nodes.body: <<FILL role=setup words=34 beats='the snack trolley squeaks in and everyone finds their place at the low table; on the shelf the cups are lined up in a row, red, green, yellow, and the space where the blue one goes is empty'>>

<<FILL role=setup words=40 beats='the blue cup is the one with the little chip on the handle and it is not on the shelf and not in the sink; Meena the helper says it will be somewhere, cups do not walk; there are two good places to start'>>

<<FILL role=rising words=40 beats='the sand tray still has yesterday's castle in it and a lot of buried things; digging is allowed as long as the sand stays in the tray, which is a rule everybody knows and nobody quite manages'>>

choices.label: Dig down where the castle is.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=rising words=40 beats='the book corner is all cushions and a low shelf, and things do get left in there; under the big cushion is warm and dark and full of crumbs and one sock'>>

choices.label: Dig down where the castle is.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=rising words=40 beats='the digging turns up a spoon, a small plastic sheep, and a lid; the lid is blue and for one whole second it looks exactly right, and then it is only a lid'>>

choices.label: Go out to the water tray.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=rising words=40 beats='under the cushions there is no cup, but there is a puddle-shaped dry patch on the carpet, the kind a cup leaves when it has been standing somewhere a while'>>

choices.label: Sit down and have snack anyway.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=rising words=40 beats='asking out loud who has seen the blue cup makes the whole table think at once, which is loud; two people say the water tray and one person says the moon'>>

<<FILL role=rising words=40 beats='the water tray is out in the corridor since this morning, with its jugs and its funnels and its one small boat; everything in it is wet and everything in it is blue-ish in this light'>>

choices.label: Put everything back where it goes.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=rising words=40 beats='sitting back down at the table is allowed too; the snack is apple slices and there is a red cup free, and Meena does not make a fuss about it either way'>>

<<FILL role=rising words=40 beats='there it is, standing in the water tray behind the big jug with the chip on the handle facing away, which is why nobody saw it; it is full of water and a small plastic fish'>>
<<FILL role=rising words=40 beats='the red cup turns out to be fine, and the apple slices taste the same out of any colour; from here the blue cup is still missing and the snack is still happening'>>

<<FILL role=discovery words=40 beats='the looking turns into tidying without anybody deciding to: the spoon goes back, the sheep goes back, the sock goes in the basket, and the room is better than it was even though the cup is not found'>>
<<FILL role=completion words=40 beats='Meena is told exactly where it is not, which turns out to be worth a lot; she says that is proper helping, and they go and look at the last place together'>>

<<FILL role=completion words=40 beats='the cup gets carried very carefully to the sink with both hands, tipped out, washed, and put on the shelf in its own space; the row of cups is right again and the fish goes back in the water tray'>>

<<FILL role=success words=40 beats='the blue cup arrives at the table at exactly the right moment and gets filled, and drinking out of it is as good as it always is; the chip on the handle sits under one thumb the way it always does'>>

<<FILL role=discovery words=40 beats='someone else at the table likes blue best too, and the cup goes to them instead; giving it away turns out to feel surprisingly good, and the red cup is still perfectly fine'>>
<<FILL role=setback words=40 beats='snack finishes before the cup is found, and that is that for today; Meena writes BLUE CUP on the whiteboard so tomorrow starts with everybody already looking'>>
